hero.title: Yassine Brief and Overview
hero.subtitle: Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Vilnius, Lithuania, Yassine is Europe’s leading second-hand fashion marketplace, driven by a mission to make second-hand the first choice worldwide. Its ecosystem includes a peer-to-peer marketplace, logistics, secure payments, and circular economy initiatives
